item.title: Anthropic report: 5 ways Claude was exploited for war, spying and repression
item.description: The AI safety debate intensified this week over warnings that the technology could one day destroy humanity. Anthropic's latest threat report offers more detail.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs urge slower AI development
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for an immediate slowdown in AI development, warning of potentially devastating consequences.

item.title: Behind the Curtain: It's not too late
item.description: The White House, Congress, and leading AI companies have allowed AI to grow faster, stronger, and more lucrative, and potentially more dangerous.

item.title: OpenAI delays IPO amid AI safety concerns, Sam Altman says
item.description: OpenAI will not go public this year due to safety work, CEO Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview released Saturday.
